Bear with me guys, aside from the first suggestion to make cross-posting easier the rest of the post is just brainstorming.

----------

Alright, my main idea is to simply make it easier to cross-post, so that when a user is making a new post they have the option to cross-post to as many subverses as they want. Possibly allow other users who think a post would be good in another sub cross-post it further after it's been submitted.

----------

Building upon the previous idea, we could even have the comments and/or upvotes shared between the cross-posts, that way everything's collected into one post instead of spread out across the site. Although, this could just cause a drowning out of most of the good comments or horribly unbalanced vote counts in smaller subs.

----------

Building on the previous idea further, we could show all of the subverses that a post was cross-posted to and allow user to vote on whether or not it belongs in that subverse. Acting sort of like a pseudo-tag. Although, thinking about it, this would kind of be like simply having sub specific voting in the first place.

----------

Anyway, tell me what you think. Are there some serious problems with these ideas? Are they too far removed from the current site design? Go ahead, burst my bubble :P
